Each day you receive up to 20 rotated questions of the chosen level, with balanced subjects and answers. The program goes through Preuniversity, 1st to 6th year, Internal and Residences.

Coco Med is an educational and recreational tool created to learn and strengthen medical knowledge through the game. it does not represent an official study plan nor guarantees preparation for university or specialty exams.
Coco Med allows one exam per day. Your next mission will open tomorrow.
Coco Med uses your Coco account in Form, but competes in an independent league.

DNA — Stores hereditary information in a sequence of nucleotides.
femoral artery — The continuation of the external iliac artery beyond the inguinal ligament.
diaphragm — The main muscle used for inhalation.
solvent — The medium that dissolves the solute and is usually present in the greater proportion.
electron — A negatively charged subatomic particle that occupies atomic orbitals.
hepatocyte — The main functional cell of the liver.
hyperkalemia — An elevated serum potassium concentration.
lysosome — Contains hydrolytic enzymes that break down macromolecules and cell components.
arithmetic mean — The sum of the values divided by the number of observations.
median — The middle value of an ordered data set.
plasma membrane — Forms the cell boundary and selectively controls the exchange of substances.
mitochondrion — Produces most of the ATP generated by aerobic cellular respiration.
mode (statistics) — The value that occurs most often.
molarity — The amount of solute in moles per litre of solution.
neutron — A particle in the atomic nucleus with no net electric charge.
cell nucleus — Contains most of a eukaryotic cell’s DNA and helps regulate gene expression.
prevalence — Measures existing cases in a population.
proton — A positively charged subatomic particle in the atomic nucleus.
range — The difference between the maximum and minimum values.
ribosome — Translates the information in messenger RNA to make proteins.
solute — The substance that dissolves in a solvent.
